duplicate_policy: same start and full moves share game_id regardless of PGN headers/results; retain all archive/member/ordinal/LichessURL provenance; reject identity conflicts

engine.assets: embedded NNUE; no separate runtime assets; Syzygy disabled
engine.build: local official release source build; make -j2 build ARCH=apple-silicon COMP=clang; Apple clang 15.0.0; O3/LTO/NEON_DOTPROD; no PGO

expansion_policy: measure coverage/costs/learning curves before 100k, several hundred thousand or optional 1m; preserve assignments and heldouts; repeat overlap audits
game_id_format: g:SHA256(canonical UTF-8 JSON of identity_version, normalized six-field start_fen and full actual moves_uci; sorted keys, compact separators, no newline)
heldout_policy: freeze validation/test game assignments and sample registries; never train or replay
overlap_requirements: audit pieces/side/castling/legal en-passant independent of counters/network history; distinct plies and rule positions per game; remove cross-split overlap before annotation; report phase/split counts before/after, removals/refill/expansion

preparation.phase_boundaries: material-ply-v1: endgame first when combined nonpawn/nonking material (N=3,B=3,R=5,Q=9) <=14; otherwise opening at sample_ply<20 from declared start; otherwise middlegame; counters and source results do not set phase
preparation.sampling_algorithm: phase-spread-sha256-v1: seed=20261009; eligible roots 0..mainline length strictly before first actual-occurrence-v1 terminal; earliest occurrence per four-field legal-EP rule position per game; missing phases in opening/middlegame/endgame order choose nearest phase ply midpoint; then maximize minimum ply distance from retained roots; ties by SHA256 compact sorted ASCII JSON {game_id,sample_ply,sampling_version,seed}, then ply; limit eight; test>validation>train ownership of selected positions; remove lower-split overlaps then refill using same selector with survivors locked; freeze heldout game assignments and sample registry; expansion preserves all existing samples and adds training only, never protected rule positions
preparation.split_algorithm: game-sha256-threshold-v1: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON {game_id,seed,split_version}; sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true, no newline; full digest as unsigned big-endian integer x; train if 100*x < 90*2**256, validation if 100*x < 95*2**256, otherwise test; seed=20261008; assignment targets 90/5/5

storage_layout: UTF-8 JSONL: games once with authoritative replay/history/source/result; samples reference game_id and sample_ply with root/provenance/class/soft WDL/search info; no repeated moves or dense one-hot policies

teacher.failure_policy: retry or explicitly exclude; never count as a successful label
teacher.hash_reset: Clear Hash before each independent annotation
teacher.missing_wdl_policy: failure; no centipawn conversion or PGN-result substitution
